headword: {接触不良|せっしょくふりょう}

definitions.gloss: poor contact; loose connection; faulty connection
definitions.explanation: An imperfect electrical connection that causes intermittent operation or failure of a device. A common cause of electronic device malfunctions, where a plug, cable, or connector does not make reliable contact.

examples.japanese: {接触不良|せっしょくふりょう}で⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{映|うつ}らない→映る：12964_utsuru⟧。
examples.english: The screen doesn't show anything due to a poor connection.

examples.japanese: ⟦イヤホン→イヤホン：04421_iyahon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{接触不良|せっしょくふりょう}で⟦{片方|かたほう}→片方：03044_katahou⟧しか⟦{聞|き}こえない→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: Due to a loose connection in the earphones, I can only hear from one side.

examples.japanese: ⟦ケーブル→ケーブル：04432_keeburu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{接触不良|せっしょくふりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ケーブル→ケーブル：04432_keeburu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{試|ため}して→試す：02130_tamesu⟧みて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: I think the cause is a faulty cable connection, so please try with a different cable.

notes:
USAGE:
A technical term that has become part of everyday vocabulary due to the prevalence of electronic devices. When a device works intermittently or only when a cable is held in a certain position, {接触不良|せっしょくふりょう} is usually the suspected cause.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {接触不良|せっしょくふりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧ (a poor connection occurs)
- {接触不良|せっしょくふりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|なお}す (to fix a loose connection)
- {接触不良|せっしょくふりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧ (the cause is a poor connection)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{断線|だんせん}→断線：20692_dansen⟧: broken wire — a complete break in a cable or wire
- ⟦{故障|こしょう}→故障：01405_koshou⟧: malfunction — a general term for any breakdown
